scope: Read-only bounded frozen candidate replay/control review under the sealed Python runtime; no Sui/build/test/RPC/signing/git commands executed. Offline parsing, hashing and in-memory validation only.

resolved_findings.title: Optimization removes required lock graph validation
resolved_findings.problem: Ten validation asserts disappear when Python runs with -O, -OO or PYTHONOPTIMIZE. Version, manifest digest, local graph edge, package identity and unsupported dependency checks cease to reject malformed inputs.
resolved_findings.evidence: Offline compile(optimize=0) rejects a manifest containing dep-replacements; optimize=1 and optimize=2 accept it and compute a digest. No Sui command was executed.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Replace all validation asserts with explicit require/ValueError checks and verify the rejection behavior at normal, -O and -OO optimization.
resolved_findings.resolution: All ten assertions were replaced with explicit require/ValueError checks. No validation assert remains. Independent normal/optimize1/optimize2 checks reject malformed manifests, locators, lock digests and edges.

resolved_findings.title: Default entry point selects an unsupported unsealed Python runtime
resolved_findings.problem: The env python3 entry point resolves to Python 3.9.6, which cannot import tomllib. The working bundled Python 3.12.14 is not specified or sealed in verification-config/verification-seal.
resolved_findings.evidence: Read-only import under default Python raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named tomllib. Bundled Python SHA is 2498a31965647f1507a53e391842b23c29d96f0ef4550475f34a1d2b30c23ddb.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Use an explicit launcher that locates and validates the reviewed runtime before importing the verifier/helper, and pin runtime identity in the reviewed controls/evidence.
resolved_findings.resolution: Selected bundled Python 3.12.14 path, resolved binary, SHA and version are sealed; load_controls verifies them. Config explicitly makes no default-python3 compatibility claim. Coordinator must install/verify its default-Python launcher selecting this sealed runtime before actual replay.

resolved_findings.title: Actual mode does not enforce frozen original controls before replay
resolved_findings.problem: Actual mode omits original_before == original_inputs. Thirty-four original legacy refusal fixture files lie outside the actual input inventory; a modification before replay is accepted as a new baseline and can still produce original_inputs_unchanged=true.
resolved_findings.evidence: All 217 original frozen files currently match, but resolving original_paths against the 254 actual configured input paths leaves 34 unguarded old fixture files.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Define original_actual_expected using reviewed payload hashes for original paths present in payload-map, preserving frozen original_inputs hashes for unaffected paths, and require equality before actual replay. Continue before/after unchanged checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Actual mode now requires all 217 original inputs to match actual_original_inputs. Independent recomputation shows 183 paths derive exactly from reviewed payload, including 63 changed hashes; all 34 unaffected historical paths retain original pins.

resolved_findings.title: Refusal source check accepts a secondary location
resolved_findings.problem: The first diagnostic code is required, but any location inside that diagnostic may satisfy refusal source identity. A first diagnostic originating in a dependency with a secondary location at refusal.move could pass.
resolved_findings.evidence: All 16 current replay records already have ./sources/refusal.move as their first primary location. The any-location predicate is broader than that reviewed evidence.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Require the first primary source location to be the staged refusal source and reject a synthetic expected-code/wrong-first/right-secondary case offline.
resolved_findings.resolution: refusal_diagnostic now requires the first diagnostic code and first primary source location. Independent expected-code/wrong-first/right-secondary and wrong-first-code/later-right cases reject in all optimization modes; all 16 historical real refusal logs still satisfy the stricter predicate.

handbook.remaining_exit_criteria: All four candidate controls resolved. Coordinator-owned actual import/launcher/single replay remain separate acceptance checks; existing owners and full goal unchanged.

Run one actual 45-command staged replay; verify input/control/cache/frozen originals and raw/module equivalence using this v2 config.
